messages:
zoe-partnerships: Heads up — pushing a joint SI listing next sprint. We need SOC/pen/Qs packaged for the marketplace gating. Timeline: target go-live 2024-06-12. Who owns what? :eyes:

nina-compliance: Hi! I can own the compliance bundle. Need: latest SOC2 Type II report (pdf), pen-test summary + remediation attest, vendor questionnaire answers, accessory artifacts (network diagram, data flow). Redaction guidance: mark all customer PII, replace with [REDACTED]. Deadline internal: 2024-06-03.

sam-security: Re pen tests — we need the pen-test scope and final report redacted for findings. Also require contact for external assessor for follow-up Qs. If they only have a summary, we'll accept but need attest from SI on remediation dates.

jen-partnereng: Partner asked if we can accept signed attestations instead of full reports for a couple of modules. Is that ok? Also where should they upload artifacts?

nina-compliance: Signed attestations ok for non-prod infra items but not for SOC2. All artifacts go to our secure intake bucket. Use presigned URL flow — I'll generate presign and TTL (48h).

liam-integrations: Any special asks for HW/SI that includes firmware/HSM? Partner has an HSM-backed key store and will share attestation certs.

sam-security: For HSM/firmware, we need the attestation cert + firmware hash + vendor manifest. Also indicate whether attestation was run with vendor-supplied or third-party tool.

marketplace-bot: Reminder: evidence intake created — upload link expires in 48h: https://uploads.redwood.ai/presign/abcd1234 (ttl=48h)

zoe-partnerships: Thanks @nina @sam. I'll ping partner with the checklist and the presign link. @jen can you draft the announcement checklist? We need to gate copy and compliance sign-off.

jen-partnereng: On it. Draft checklist items: compliance sign-off, SOC summary, pen remediation statement, integration smoke test report, marketplace listing assets. Will post draft by EOD.

nina-compliance: One more: include the scope statement for data residency and log retention. If partner uses EU region, we need their data processing agreement snippet.

zoe-partnerships: Copy. Partner point: @alex (not in thread) — can you help Alex get the DPA snippet? cc @jen. :thumbsup: 

sam-security: Quick note: label all uploaded filenames with partner name + doc type, e.g., `acme-soc2-2024.pdf`, `acme-pen-summary-2024.pdf` to speed triage.

liam-integrations: If partner wants to attach logs, prefer a tar.gz and include a small README with collection date and sample commands.

zoe-partnerships: OK locking this — we'll aim for artifacts by 2024-06-01. Anyone object? If not, I'll close the loop with partner and set owners.

nina-compliance: No objections.

sam-security: No objections. I'll standby for assessor contact.

jen-partnereng: no objections — will post announcement checklist link once ready.

marketplace-bot: Thread archived to 'partnerships' evidence queue by @nina-compliance.
